answer: A durable agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making every new identity carry locked stake in a vault that is slashed when its attestations prove false. Peers only gain witness weight after weeks of unique, publicly checked work, so an attacker spawning a lantern of cheap aliases lights nothing: each alias starts at zero weight and must earn non-kin witnesses before any payout. Even an ocean of fresh keys cannot witness itself into rewards, because closed clusters are discounted and honest stake is forfeited for endorsing duplicates.
